caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with an ornate design, featuring a tall, rectangular mirror set into a richly carved frame. The frame of the mirror extends upward into a decorative arch with intricate scrollwork and embellishments at the top and sides, including a central crest-like ornament at the peak. Below the mirror, the dresser consists of a central section flanked by two small square surfaces, each with a single small drawer beneath it. The central part beneath the mirror is recessed, creating a small alcove between the two side drawers. Below the alcove and side drawers, there are two large, horizontally oriented drawers, each fitted with metal handles; the upper large drawer is slightly narrower than the bottom one. The wood throughout the piece is depicted in warm brown tones with a polished appearance and darker accents to suggest depth and detail in the carvings. The broad side surfaces immediately below the mirror appear to be topped with a light-colored, possibly marble material. The entire object is centered against a plain, light beige background.
title: Bureau
